utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just so you know, I'll be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great, Oren. I have an old toaster I was thinking of bringing to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: An old toaster, huh? I can take a look at it before the drive starts if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a basic toolkit and some spare parts ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive... wait, which one was that again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The one for the community center's plumbing, remember?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Gus, got any broken stuff for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I've got an old blender that's been sitting in the garage. Think you can fix it up?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, bring it by Saturday morning and I'll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just a heads-up, Rosa has set aside her whole Saturday for the drive, and Oren mentioned he'll try to get there early.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good to know, I'll be there early too to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Sam! The more early birds, the better.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that's what happened?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, I double-checked with Vik. He told me you're organizing the drive for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Vik told you that? Are you sure he's reliable?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Eli! Heard you're organizing that neighborhood repair drive — how's it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's coming along nicely, Tess. I've got a schedule and sign-up sheet ready. Just need a few more volunteers to fill the slots.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'd love to help out! Count me in for a shift — do you still need hands on Saturday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, how's the repair drive going? Heard you've been busy organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's coming together well! I've got a map of all the spots that need repairs, and Rosa's bringing tool kits later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great to hear! Need any help passing out the map or anything?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive? I'm... not sure I can help much right now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh come on, it'll be quick. Just hand over the hard drive or something.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I don't have one to give. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Rey, I heard about the repair drive — do you need any help organizing schedules for the volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye. Tess is bringing her old toaster, so maybe we can pair her with someone who knows small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds like a good plan. I can help match people up if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Looks like Ira and Jules are both coming to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great news! I'll make sure the tool kits are ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Ira and Jules are both coming to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly is the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's for fixing up the old community center—gathering tools and volunteers to patch the roof and paint the walls.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you need me to bring, then?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Dane, are you sure that repair drive is going to work? I hope you have a backup plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Pia, don't worry—I've got a couple of tricks up my sleeve if this drive doesn't pan out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to hear you have a backup, but I still wish we had a more solid guarantee.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I heard Tess is bringing her old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Is it even safe to use? We should check the wiring first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that's a good idea. Maybe we should look at it together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools I can lend out if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Who told you about that? I haven't seen any official notice.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I thought I saw a flyer at the community center. Maybe I was mistaken.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Jules, have you heard about the community repair drive this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old electronics for free.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I'm participating! I've been mapping out who's got what tools and skills around here, so I'm excited to help connect everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great! I know Mrs. Chen down the street has a soldering iron she never uses—maybe she'd lend it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Vik. You mentioned a repair drive—can you tell me more about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive! Ira and Jules are definitely coming to help out. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, so the three of us will be working together. Can you describe what specific repairs are most urgent?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you order the parts for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, not yet—I've been running errands all morning. I'll get to it soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you pick them up after lunch? I'll drive you if you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw something about that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, really? I just got here—what's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it's to fix the old playground equipment or something. I can never remember exactly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, a repair drive? When is it scheduled? I need to check the school calendar for any conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's on Saturday, March 12th, from 9 AM to 3 PM. I hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: March 12th? Let me just glance at my calendar—I think that's a free weekend, but I'll double-check with the school events list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Uli, I heard Oren plans to arrive early, and Rosa has set aside the whole Saturday for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, that's good to know. I'll try to be there too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Uli! Every bit of help makes a difference.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Sam, what's the plan for the repair drive? I like to have things organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I figured we could start by gathering some basic tools and seeing what needs fixing. How about we meet at my garage later?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, a specific time would be good. How about 2 PM?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, speaking of the repair drive, I have an old toaster that might be useful for parts or fixing up. Should I bring it by?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, bring it over Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll drop it off Saturday morning. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, I see you've mapped out all the repair spots. I'll have the tool kits ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Rosa! I've got the map with the exact locations marked—I'll share it with you and Jules before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I'll have everything organized on my end. Thanks for coordinating the map, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Bo, I'll be there early to help with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem, I'll bring my toolbox.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
